headline: CCE Sees Near Agreement Between Mexico and US to Reduce Tariffs
summary: The head of Mexico's business council CCE said a deal between Mexico and the US to reduce tariffs could be close, with a Sheinbaum-Trump meeting planned during the G20.
why: Tariffs affect trade flows between Mexico and the United States, its largest export market, and therefore Mexican company margins and the peso.
original_headline: CCE vislumbra acuerdo cercano entre México y EU para reducir aranceles
